name: Resurrect
source:
Hero dies in the introduction. However, if he is loved by four women in four days, he has a chance to resurrect.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-october-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在序章中死亡。然而，只要4天内获得4名女性的爱，他就有机会复活。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-october-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
